hero.title: Become an Authorized Training Partner
hero.description: Join a national network of institutions delivering quality, standards-based training with certificates employers trust.

benefits.title: NYTI authorization
benefits.body: Display the Authorized Partner badge and be listed in the public directory.

benefits.title: Reach more learners
benefits.body: Receive enrolments from the NYTI platform for your classroom batches.

benefits.title: Verifiable certificates
benefits.body: Issue certificates backed by the national verification registry.

process.title: Apply
process.body: Submit your organization profile and supporting documents.

process.title: Review
process.body: NYTI assesses facilities, instructors and assessment processes.

process.title: Site visit
process.body: An NYTI officer inspects your training center.

process.title: Authorization
process.body: Receive your authorization number and start delivering programmes.
